power.jaymospowers.darktide.desc: Water and darkness. Guard, parry and answer with a blade; your Flow rises in the deep and in the dark.
power.jaymospowers.darktide.key.starter: Guard: hold right click (bare hands, a katana or a knife) to block blows from the front for Flow; raise it just as one lands to parry
power.jaymospowers.darktide.key.ability_: Dark Strike: a quick, heavy blow; after a parry, wreathed in darkness for a crushing one (25 Flow)
Dark Strike; with a knife, Pounce: hold to raise both blades, let go to leap onto your enemy's back
Katana: Crescent, a wide slash through up to 3 foes. Knife: Ink Cross, a crossing cut that slows
Katana: Crescent. Knife: Fang Barrage (hold): slash everything in front of you, held fast, then stunned
Undertow: sink into water or a shadow where you look and surface there
Black Tide: a wave of dark water rolls forward, sweeping foes along and blinding them
Black Tide; with a knife, Riptide Dash (hold %1$s too for a flurry on the first foe)
power.jaymospowers.darktide.key.mode: Veil on/off: ink hides you from mobs at a distance (drains Flow)
power.jaymospowers.darktide.key.special: Gedan: Stillwater (katana, hold): stand still as a field spreads; let go to strike every foe in it from below
power.jaymospowers.darktide.key.ultimate: Tide Arms: bare hands, twin daggers or a katana of dark water
Drown: fill a sphere around your target with water
Necromancy: hold on a corpse to take its shadow, tap to raise one (otherwise Tide Arms)
message.jaymospowers.darktide.blade_only: Your hands are empty. This needs a blade.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.no_shadow: No water or shadow to surface in there.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.whisper_15: The blade remembers every blow it turned aside.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.whisper_30: Something deep beneath the water is listening to your steel.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.shadows_fu: You can hold no more shadows.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.shadow_los: The shadow slips away before it can stand.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.no_weaponm: There are no blades in this world to shape the water into.
